name: UnfinishedTestAssertion
summary: Fails on purpose to say the test is not written yet, so that a missing test is a red bar rather than an absence.

roles.name: UnfinishedTestAssertion
roles.summary: A test that exists to be missing. It turns a gap into something the build reports, which is the only form in which a gap gets fixed — and it is the one annotation here whose value is that somebody comes back and removes it.
